name: bb-plugin-pulse
description: A live board of what needs you from Slack, Gmail and Calendar, kept current by scheduled bb agent runs.

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.mjs && node --experimental-transform-types --import ./test/resolve-ts.mjs --test test/*.test.ts && node --import tsx --import ./test/ui-loader.mjs --test test/*.test.tsx

bb.name: Pulse
bb.description: One live board of what needs you from Slack, Gmail and Calendar. Scheduled agent runs write the items; Done and Snooze stick; quick actions copy a prepared reply; the robot hands an item to an agent thread.
